Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Cursor Agent
Message:
Fail closed when COLONIAL_MASTER_SECRET is unset or short.

Remove the hardcoded fallback from the cipher, lattice bands, sovereign kernel, and colonial language kernel. Operations that need the secret report colonial-secret-not-configured, and routes that reach them return 503 without the secret or its length.

Co-authored-by: Tessera <vitalitychems-dot@users.noreply.github.com>
